title: VTG Asterix Obelix Panoramix Comic Art Hand Colored Illustration French 26x17
descriptionText:
Vintage Asterix comic art illustration featuring Asterix, Obelix, and Panoramix with French captions.
The artwork appears to be a black line illustration that has been hand colored with colored pencil or crayon and mounted to a backing board.
Text on the illustration references the characters and magical potions from the classic French comic series.
Details
Characters: Asterix, Obelix, Panoramix
Language: French
Type: Illustration / comic art print
Mounted on board
Approximate size
26 inches tall
17 inches wide
Condition
Visible age toning to the paper
Mounting board shows wear and edge chips
Some stains and marks on the board
Light surface wear from age
Please review photos carefully for condition.
Great decorative piece for collectors of Asterix comics, French comic art, or vintage illustration.
